title: 第25章 闺中密谈第26章 太乙五行拳与挑衅
content_zh:
“当然，‘八卦明光镜’既然能‘推算’物品的位置，也就能干扰他人测定方位，所以以它为核心的‘万镜大阵’才能将地祇封印在镜界，让其找不到回到现实的路。
“目前来说，只要有星槎丢失的部件出现在以我为中心，方圆十公里内，‘八卦明光镜’就会自动提示……但想要测定具体位置，却需要视具体情况而定，最低100星币，上不封顶……
“而帮我抵挡一次他人推算我的方位，也同样是这个价格。
“另外，还需要至少‘旅行商人’的箓位。”
想到箓位，赵晨的目光又投向了书案左侧的那枚“九曜金章”
，在“八卦明光镜”
被成功回收后，其就给出了受箓九品的具体仪式内容，只要自己在现实完成仪式，就能被受箓为九品的“星河转运副使”
，或者说序列9“旅行商人”
那仪式倒并不麻烦，需要的东西根据原主的记忆也很容易买到，但那位从七品的道官燕红霞还在调查潜伏于冰泉镇的邪恶组织，贸然购买仪式用品很容易惹来怀疑……
更何况我现在经济并不独立，作为冰泉镇大土豪大商人赵嵩的儿子，在镇内买东西大部分时候只需要“刷脸”
就行，自有家里给付账单，从师傅那买安神香时就是如此……
但这也意味着我的消费记录是透明的。
略作思考后，赵晨就决定先等几天，待燕红霞离开后再举行仪式，他也好趁机攒点私房钱。
将视线从“九曜金章”
上移开，赵晨再次点开了“玉册”
，翻至兑换物品列表页，找到了《金楼玉室十二重门行气秘录》完美翻译版。
从镜村归来后，赵晨再次深刻地认识到自己实力的不足。
以目前这点水准，别说去进行自己热爱的“冒险”
，就连安身立命怕是都很成问题。
毕竟祁姑娘说过，了解“妖邪”

、接触“妖邪”
后，在命运层面也便和“妖邪”
有了联系，未来遇到它们的可能就越大。
而想要提升实力，除了“受箓”
外，最靠谱的还是在修行上更进一步，尽快达到“通玄”
第一境的“真气”
境界。
因此，一部靠谱的秘籍是必不可少的。
而自己能接触到的真气境功法里，就数太初道君嫡传的《金楼玉室十二重门行气秘录》品质最高。
虽然王道一的《秘传神风九剑真诀》也很不错，但一来它没有被拆开单卖，全本6000星币的价格赵晨还消费不起；
二来其最高成就只到“通玄”
第五境“神通”
，潜力差了《金楼玉室十二重门行气秘录》许多……
所以赵晨只打算将这《秘传神风九剑真诀》当做未来的备选，如果自己真气境后没能找到更好的后续功法，再考虑转修它。
content_en:
"Of course, since the 'Bagua Mingguang Mirror' can 'calculate' the location of objects, it can also interfere with others' determination of orientation. Therefore, the 'Ten Thousand Mirrors Array' with it as the core can seal the earth in the mirror world, so that it cannot find its way back to reality.
"Currently, as long as a missing part of Xingcha appears within a radius of ten kilometers with me as the center, the 'Bagua Mingguang Mirror' will automatically prompt... But if you want to determine the specific location, you need to determine the specific situation. The minimum is 100 star coins, and there is no upper limit...
"The price for helping me resist someone else's calculation of my position is also the same.
“In addition, you need to be at least a ‘traveling merchant’. "
Thinking of the urn position, Zhao Chen's eyes turned to the "Nine Lights Gold Medal" on the left side of the desk.
, in "Bagua Mingguang Mirror"
After being successfully recovered, he gave the specific content of the ceremony to receive the ninth grade. As long as he completes the ceremony in reality, he can be accepted as the "Galactic Transport Deputy Envoy" of the ninth grade.
, or Sequence 9 "Traveling Merchant"
The ritual is not troublesome, and the required items are easy to buy based on the memory of the original owner. However, Yan Hongxia, a seventh-grade Taoist official, is still investigating the evil organization lurking in Bingquan Town. Buying ritual supplies rashly can easily arouse suspicion...
What's more, I am not financially independent now. As the son of Zhao Song, a wealthy businessman in Bingquan Town, most of the time I only need to "swipe my face" to buy things in the town.
That’s fine, you can pay the bills at home, just like when you buy Anshen incense from the master...
But it also means my spending records are transparent.
After thinking for a while, Zhao Chen decided to wait a few days before holding the ceremony after Yan Hongxia left. He could also take the opportunity to save some private money.
Turn your attention away from the "Nine Lights Golden Medal"
Moving up, Zhao Chen clicked on the "Jade Book" again.
, turned to the exchange item list page, and found the perfectly translated version of "The Secret Records of the Twelve Gates of the Golden House and the Jade Chamber".
After returning from Mirror Village, Zhao Chen once again deeply realized his lack of strength.
With the current level, let alone go on the "adventure" that I love.
, even settling down and making a living may be very problematic.
After all, Miss Qi said, understand "evil"
, contact with "evil"
Later, on the level of fate, he also had to deal with "evils".
The more connections you have, the more likely you are to encounter them in the future.
And if you want to improve your strength, other than "suffering"
In addition, the most reliable thing is to take a step further in practice and reach "tongxuan" as soon as possible
The first level of "Qi"
realm.
Therefore, a reliable cheat book is essential.
Among the true qi realm techniques that he has access to, the "Secret Records of the Twelve Doors of the Golden Tower and Jade Chamber" passed down by Taojun Taichu is the highest quality.
Although Wang Daoyi's "Secret Kamikaze Nine Swords" is also very good, it has not been dismantled and sold individually, and the price of the whole book is 6,000 star coins, which Zhao Chen cannot afford;
Secondly, its highest achievement is only "Tongxuan"
The fifth level of "supernatural power"
, the potential is much lower than that of "The Secret Records of the Twelve Doors of Jinlou and Jade Room"...
Therefore, Zhao Chen only plans to use the "Secret Divine Wind Nine Swords" as a future alternative. If he fails to find a better follow-up technique after reaching the True Qi realm, he will consider switching to it.
